text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin is set to star in a commercial, which is being filmed today. I decide to tag along with her to the set.

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew Member
text_block_list.text: And cut! I want you two to take a breather!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oookaaay!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. I was pretty nervous at first, but now I'm starting to have fun!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Ticket's abundant facial expressions are sure to convey just how fun the game is. She might actually be suited to this line of work.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Aren't you done filming your parts, Hayahide? What are you sticking around for?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It's not every day we get to act in a commercial, so I thought I'd watch them film you and Ticket as well.

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! It's brokeeen!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Huh, there's a kid crying here! This is an emergency!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hey, what happened? I'm here to help, so tell me what's going on!

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… M-my helicopter! I tripped and… now it won't wooork!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Your helicopter's broken?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: He must have dropped it when he fell. Hmm, the motor is running fine, but the propeller isn't turning at all.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: O-oh no! What do we do?! How do we fix it?! I wanna help, but I don't know anything about machines!

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: Hic. S-so you can't fix it? Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh. Give it here. The propeller probably just got jostled out of place. It should work fine once it's repositioned.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Really?! You can fix it, Taishin?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Uh, I dunno if I can, but I'll try.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Woooo, Taishin! You're incredible! You can do it! I believe in you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: This bit should go here… And this goes like that… Hmm…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: If the axle is here, then that must mean it's deviated to the right, no? In other words, the propeller's original position should be here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah, so that's how it fits. Let's see… This should do the trick.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: WHIRRRRR!

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it took off! You fixed my helicopter!

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: Wow! You're amazing, miss! You're like some engineering whiz who can fix anything!

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: Wait, there's an engineer in a game that's coming out soon! You're just like that character!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Uh, I really didn't do anything spe—

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: Thanks so much! You're the best!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That was awesome, Taishin! It was so cool how you fixed it like it was no big deal!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Seriously, I barely did anything. You're always so dramatic, I swear.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Well, you are playing a mechanical engineer in the commercial. Perhaps the call of a broken machine made your engineering sense tingle.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Shut up.

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew Member
text_block_list.text: Cameras are ready to roll again! Let's pick things back up from Narita Taishin's engineer scene!

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew Member
text_block_list.text: Okay, stand right there with the motor and… Yes, perfect! I love it! Do exactly that when the cameras are rolling!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Right, will do.

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew Member
text_block_list.text: Cut! That was perfect! Let's move on to the next scene!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin nails one scene after another, and her shoot progresses without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Gah, I'm so moved! The grand sight of Taishin coming to the rescue! The huge grin on that kid's face! It was all so beautifuuul!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Geez, now you're crying? Ugh, and just when we finally got that kid to stop…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Anyway, I'm gonna take a break over there.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Thanks, huh? I guess being an engineer might not be so bad…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin rests in the shade of a tree as she reflects on the boy's words. She smiles gently with a hint of satisfaction in her expression.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: There's no reason to get that happy over something so simple. Not like I saved the world…
choice_data_list: Feels pretty good to help others, huh?
Feels pretty good to help others, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Pfft. Like hell it does.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She brushes me off coldly, but I can see a hint of happiness in her expression.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Awww, I'm so touched! What better reward than the gift of a smile?! Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: For crying out loud! Keep it down already.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The gift of a smile is quite a fitting way to put it, though. Wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well… if you say so.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin offers a curt response, but there's an air of satisfaction about her.
